N. of Devakī, mother of Kṛiṣṇa.
The earth. -Comp. -गर्भः, -धरः, -भद्रः epithets of Viṣṇu-Kṛiṣṇa. -पर्णिका, -पर्णी Hermionitis Cordifolia (Mar. पिठवण).
of Gaṇeśa. पृश्नि (-ष्णि) -का, -पृश्नी (ष्णी) N. of an aquatic plant.

A drop of water or of any other liquid; (said by some to be used only in pl.).
Comp. अंशः अश्वः wind, air; पृषदश्वो धनेशश्च महेशश्च दिगीश्वराः Śiva

. -पतिः (-पृषतांपतिः) wind.-बलः N. of the horse of Wind.
पृषत्कः [pṛṣatkḥ], 1 An arrow; पृषत्कबाणविशिखाः Ak.; तदुपोढैश्च नभश्चरैः पृषत्कः
The versed sine of an arc; Gaṇitādhhyāya.
पृषन्तिः [pṛṣantiḥ], A drop of water; पयःपृषन्तिभिः स्पृष्टा वान्ति वाताः शनैः शनैः Bharata on Ak.
पृषाकरा [pṛṣākarā], A small stone used as a weight.
पृषातकम् [pṛṣātakam], Mixture of ghee and coagulated milk.

पृषोदरः [pṛṣōdarḥ], Wind, air. (The word is supposed to be compounded of पृषत् and उदर, the त् of पृषत् being dropped as an irregular case. The word is thus taken as the type of a whole class of such irregular compounds.) पूषोदरादित्वात् साधुः, see Gaṇa. to
पृषोद्यानम् [pṛṣōdyānam], A small garden; L. D. B.

Towards the back, backwards; गच्छ पृष्ठतः.
Behind the back, secretly, covertly. (पृष्ठतः कृ means
to place on the back, leave behind.
to renounce, desist from, leave off, resign; येनाशाः पृष्ठतः कृत्वा नैराश्यमवलम्बितम्

.-ग्रन्थि a. hump-backed. -चक्षुस् m. a crab. -तल्पनम् the exterior muscles on the back of an elephant. -तापः noon, midday.
